sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 358 gives Szondi's `psychopathische Trias`: (I) Syndrom des Lustprinzips, often also the syndrome of polymorphic perversion; (II) total or partial Verlust der Mitte, defined here as weakness of censorship toward early-childhood pleasure claims; (III) Tri- oder Quadriventilität der Triebventile, i.e. multiple emergency outlets from internal drive tensions.

sourceExcerpt: Besonders drei experimentelle Symptomeeverbände sind für psychopathische Persönlichkeiten charakteristisch :
romanianRendering: Szondi grupează sub numele `psychopathische Trias` trei complexe experimentale: Lustprinzipsyndrom, pierderea totală sau parțială a Mitte și Tri-/Quadriventilität a Triebventilelor.
doctrinalStatement: În capitolul istoric despre `Psychopathien`, Szondi definește o triadă experimentală de rang mai înalt decât exemplele de subtip: `Syndrom des Lustprinzips`; `totaler oder partieller Verlust der Mitte`; `Tri- oder Quadriventilität der Triebventile`. Triada trebuie păstrată ca schemă internă a syndromatikii sale și nu ca set modern de criterii diagnostice. Fiecare componentă necesită propria structură source-defined; simpla prezență a uneia nu autorizează etichetarea persoanei.
conditions: Use only as Szondi's historical experimental triad within the Psychopathie chapter.
exceptions: Do not convert the triad into contemporary diagnostic criteria.
Do not infer the historical category from one component in isolation.
Do not infer sexual behavior, criminality, addiction or moral status merely from the presence of one testological component.
scopeNotes: The later detailed Lustprinzip factor pattern and subtype/case material are not serialized in this compact batch.
Tri-/Quadriventilität is a source term about Triebventile; its deterministic calculation in software does not by itself inherit the historical diagnostic label.

relations.note: Condenses the three principal experimental symptom complexes that Szondi derives under his dialectical method.

ambiguities: Canonical U002764 OCR renders `Symptomenverbände` incorrectly as `Symptomeeverbände`; sourceExcerpt remains canonical-literal while printed page 358 governs terminology.
